base: Create ONE standalone transparent PNG avatar of the EXACT SAME sesame schnauzer puppy as the approved reference image. Image role: strict character identity AND drawing-style reference. Keep its sesame warm-gray head and two folded triangular ears with pale peach inner ear tips, small forehead fur tufts, two distinctive fluffy ivory eyebrows, ivory rounded cheek moustache and short scalloped beard, warm dark brown outline, small dark canine nose and pale peach blush. Preserve head/ear proportions, relative feature placement, neutral head orientation and coat colors, changing only expression and requested paw pose. The eyebrows themselves are ivory fur, never replace them with a different character's thin black brows. Draw in the same warm 2D picture-book gouache with restrained dry-brush texture inside flat colors. Front view, single whole head centered, ample transparent margin (10%), unclipped ears/tears/paws. No body, neck, clothes, hat, collar, bakery object, frame, GOLD text, locks, background tile, ground shadow, watermark, 3D or realistic fur. Never use blue ears or an eye patch.
